

		A brief description of the Graphic Tablet



1. The Graphic Tablet supports the following operating systems:

	Microsoft Windows Xp,vista, 7, 8, 10, 11 32-bit and 64-bit systems. 
	Apple Mac OS 11 and above Version of the 64-bit system. The latest supported version is Mac OS 13.
	Android 4.4 and above.
	HarmonyOS 2.0 and above.
	Ali YunOS and other Android-type set-top box operating system.
	Ubuntu 16 and above.


2. Drive Installation

	The Windows system driver is "Setup.exe"
	MAC OS drives is "Mac_tablet_driver.dmg"
	Ubuntu, Android, HarmonyOS and Yunos work properly with the system default driver, no additional drivers are required.


3. Known Issues

	MAC OSX is not supported by current driver, please download old version Mac os driver from web site.

	Please download the driver on the network or use another computer to copy the driver file to a USB DISK drive.

	When Android system turns on screen rotation, and there may be problems with the working range of the Graphic Tablet that cannot be fully matched to the screen.
